title: Knocked up Grassy American Lamb Bowl
description: A high-protein dish featuring lamb shoulder, perfect for a post-workout meal, with a grassy and creamy flavor profile. This American-inspired bowl is made with sashimi-cut lamb and fresh ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb shoulder with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the lamb for 2 minutes per side.
Finish cooking the lamb in the oven for 10 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, crumbly feta cheese, and sliced lamb.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, and minced garlic.
Pour the yogurt sauce over the lamb and greens, and toss to combine.
